events.name: CPI / Inflation Rate
events.description: Consumer Price Index and year-on-year inflation rate for Kenya.

events.name: MPC Interest Rate Decision
events.typicalDate: Every 2 months (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov)
events.description: Central Bank Rate (CBR) decision by the Monetary Policy Committee.

events.name: EPRA Fuel Prices
events.description: Maximum retail pump prices for petrol, diesel, kerosene by region.

events.name: CBK Weekly Bulletin
events.description: Interbank rates, forex reserves, money supply, government securities.

events.name: GDP Estimate (Quarterly)
events.description: Quarterly Gross Domestic Product estimate and sectoral growth rates.

events.name: Balance of Trade
events.description: Imports vs exports, trade deficit/surplus, top trading partners.

events.name: CBK Monetary Policy Report
events.description: Comprehensive monetary policy analysis, outlook, and CBR rationale.

events.name: National Budget Statement
events.description: Annual government budget reading in Parliament. Revenue and expenditure plans.

events.name: Economic Survey
events.description: Comprehensive annual review of Kenya's economy — the 'state of the nation' economic report.

events.name: Controller of Budget Reports
events.description: National and county government budget implementation reports. Revenue, expenditure, absorption rates.

events.name: KRA Revenue Collection Report
events.description: Tax revenue collection figures vs targets. PAYE, VAT, excise, customs breakdown.

events.name: Leading Economic Indicators (LEI)
events.description: Composite index of leading indicators: cement production, electricity generation, tourism arrivals, credit.

events.name: NSE Market Report
events.description: Daily stock market summary: NSE 20, NASI, turnover, top gainers/losers.

events.name: CBK Exchange Rates
events.description: Official indicative exchange rates for major currencies against KES.

events.name: Treasury Bill/Bond Auction
events.description: Government securities auction results: 91, 182, 364-day T-Bills and infrastructure bonds.

events.name: KNBS Census Report
events.description: National Population and Housing Census. Last conducted in 2019.

notes: Dates are approximate and based on historical patterns. Actual release dates may vary.
KNBS publications are available at knbs.or.ke under 'Publications'. Most are free PDF downloads.
CBK data is published at centralbank.go.ke under 'Statistics' and 'Publications'.
For real-time alerts on Kenya economic data releases, follow KNBS, CBK, and KRA on Twitter/X.
The National Treasury publishes the Budget Policy Statement (BPS) in February and the Budget Speech in June each year.
